responsibility: Implements the x86 target option and attribute subsystem. This file owns processor and tuning tables, validation and normalization of x86 command-line and function-specific target options, target-attribute parsing, and the machine attribute handlers for calling conventions, ABI selectors, interrupt handlers, stack realignment, DLL-related attributes, CET-related attributes, and other x86-specific declaration properties, making it the executable policy layer behind i386.opt and i386-options.h.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-options.h, which only publishes shared option-state declarations and interfaces, this source file implements x86 option processing and attribute handling itself, including processor/tuning tables, option normalization, and the machine attribute handlers and attribute table.
